title: [SOA] Ignore extended-text lines when editing sales quotes
summary: Sales Order Agent now filters out extended-text lines from the sales quote view to prevent the agent from getting stuck when attempting to add items after automatic extended text is inserted.
key_points: Extended-text lines are excluded from the Sales Quote Subform display during agent sessions
Item lines only are shown, preventing item lookups from running on text lines
Extended text remains stored and unchanged on quotes
Change applies only during Sales Order Agent sessions; normal sessions unaffected
No impact on printed documents or existing quote data
quote: Extended-text lines remain stored on the quote but are excluded from the agent's working view.
